|rulings=* First function: After placing just drawn destiny on Reserve Deck, the destiny value can be modified, reset, or canceled, but actions requiring the physical card cannot be initiated. Examples:[[Luke Skywalker, Rebel Scout (V)]] cannot use its own text to be taken into hand to cause a redraw.[[Jedi Levitation (V)]] cannot take the card into hand to cause a redraw.Both functions of You Do Have Your moments (V) ''can'' played (these functions do not require a physical card).<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=You%20Swindled%20Me%21%20%28V%29 Scomp: You Swindled Me! (V)]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* First function: If the destiny has been canceled, or if the card has already been placed somewhere else (such as [[Sando Aqua Monster (Dark){{!}}Sando Aqua Monster]]), it is no longer 'just drawn' so You Swindled Me (V) may not target it.
* Second function: The card taken into hand is not revealed to the opponent.
